newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Enterprise unit sets US$60 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Enterprise unit sets US$60 mln loan.

text.p: Guangdong Finance Co Ltd's US$60 million loan facility is in general syndication, bankers said.
The facility was originally expected to be US$40 million but was increased to US$60 million due to oversubscription in the underwriting stage, they said.
The borrower is 100 percent owned by Guangdong Enterprise Holdings Ltd, which also is the guarantor of the deal.
The amortising loan has a final maturity of three years with an average life of 2.5 years.
It pays an interest margin of 112.5 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is around 150 basis points, bankers noted.
Arranger Societe Generale Asia underwrote US$8.5 million of the transaction.
Senior co-arrangers First National Bank of Chicago, LTCB Hong Kong and Nippon Credit Bank HongKong each have underwritten US$8.5 million.
Co-arrangers Banco Exterior de Espana HongKong, KDB Asia, Kookmin Bank and Mitsubishi Trust Hongkong each have underwritten US$6.5 million.
Syndication is expected to close at the end of this month.
